svg.title: Transform engines and storage
svg.desc: Separate iterative FFT and IFFT engines reuse one registered butterfly per engine.
svg.text: Separate iterative FFT and IFFT engines reuse one registered butterfly per engine.
Local count assumes a complete, available frame and a ready output.
Load, compute and output phases do not overlap
inside one engine. Reset invalidates ownership;
frame RAM payload is not bulk reset.
Canonicalizer 256 x 56; input history 512 x 76; delayed
history 1024 x 76; WOLA frame 256 x 36 and OLA ring
Twiddles: 256 x 17 per component; frozen artifacts.
Architecture source snapshot 2026-09-14 / Implementation structure; hardware operation is a separate milestone.
